name: Grade 8 IT Practice: April Week 7 - HTML and CSS
description: Practice words for Grade 8 first-trimester work.

words.definition: Markup used to structure a web page.
words.example: HTML created the structure of the portfolio page.

words.definition: The part of HTML with page information.
words.example: The head included the page title for the browser tab.

words.definition: The part of HTML shown on the page.
words.example: The body showed the heading, paragraph, image, and link.

words.definition: A title for a page or section.
words.example: The heading named the campaign at the top of the page.

words.definition: A group of sentences about one idea.
words.example: The paragraph explained the purpose of the campaign.

words.definition: A group of related items stored together.
words.example: The list showed three safety tips in order.

words.definition: A way to open a web page or file.
words.example: The link opened the source used for the research.

words.definition: Code used to style a web page.
words.example: CSS changed the colors and spacing of the homepage.

words.definition: CSS code that chooses what to style.
words.example: The selector chose which heading to style.

words.definition: Information stored in a variable, cell, or program.
words.example: The color value changed the text from black to blue.
